test_title: SSC Stenographer 2024 Official Paper (Held On: 11 Dec, 2024 Shift 2)
subject: general
question:
Select the most appropriate meaning of the underlined word.

Sarika’s husband had been undergoing __vicissitudes__ in his fortune since 2002.
solution:
The correct answer is: **Option 3** i.e. **tribulations**.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The word **"vicissitudes"** refers to the changes and fluctuations, especially those that are unwelcome or unpleasant. (उतार-चढ़ाव)

 
 
• **Example: **The vicissitudes of life can be challenging, but they also make us stronger.
 
 
 
• **"tribulations"** refers to great troubles or suffering. (कठिनाइयों)
 
 
• **Example: **Despite the tribulations he faced, he never gave up on his dreams.
 
 
 
• Hence, we can infer that the correct meaning of **'vicissitudes'** is **'tribulations'**.

Therefore, the correct answer is: **Option 3** i.e. **tribulations**.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

Here are the other options explained along with their Hindi meanings and example sentences:

 
• **Hibernation **(शीतनिद्रा): A state of inactivity and metabolic depression in endotherms.

 
 
• **Example:** Bears go into hibernation during the winter months.
 
 
 
• **Consolations **(सांत्वना): Comfort received by a person after a loss or disappointment.
 
 
• **Example:** Her kind words were a great consolation to me during my difficult times.
 
 
 
• **Compilations** (संकलन): The action or process of collecting or assembling something.
 
 
• **Example:** The book is a compilation of her best short stories.
